Saved opening journeys captured from main commit `93cf190d93a714e574ed09844dc42b40e190a08c`, rules 103, Greek revision 20. Each file is gzip-compressed JSON from `openingFixture(branch, options)` in that commit. The late-report case uses `reportFirst: false`; the dry case uses `water: false`. These preserve the retired burial, concession and exposure paths for save-upgrade and later-journey checks. New funeral play is tested in `card-polynices-funeral.test.mjs`.

The errands before any branch (arrival, waterOffer, water, decree, traded, writ, opened) are no longer read from these files. `greekErrands()` in `test/helpers/greek-opening.mjs` plays them on the current rules from `test/journeys/greek-before-funeral.mjs`. The files stay for the retired branch states (`buried`, `returning`, `closed`, `permission`, `choice`, ...), and `exposure.json.gz` is also the rules-103 input that `card-legacy-journey-boundary.test.mjs` replays under rules 110, so it must stay frozen. The rules bump retires the rest (`docs/design/wants-and-arcs.md`).
